title: Music Worksheets | K–2nd Art & Music Printable Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Standards aligned: MU:Cr1.1k, MU:Re7.1k, MU:Re7.2k

Give your learners extra practice with Music! This no-prep printable pack has 5 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (8 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Find the Instrument
  • Blow, Hit or Strum?
  • Loud or Soft?
  • Music Patterns
  • The Big Band
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Find the Instrument, Blow, Hit or Strum?, Loud or Soft?, Music Patterns, The Big Band), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Holidays, Art & Coding Bundle and the Mega Bundle.
